meta.title: Genesis Synchronological Lifespans — Adam to Joseph
meta.basis: Relative years from Adam (AM-style), derived from the ages in Genesis 5 and 11 using the Masoretic/CUV sequence; NOT absolute BCE dates or universal chronology
meta.warning: Genesis chronologies differ across textual traditions. Every plotted start/end is a model calculation, not a verse-stated birth calendar year. Enoch was taken by God, not recorded as dying.
meta.sourcePolicy: Bible text (Genesis 5, 7–9, 11–12, 17, 21, 23, 25, 35, 41, 45, 47, 50; Acts 7:4); derivations explicitly labeled. Original-language reference: STEP Bible/Tyndale House.
meta.note: Patriarch births from Abraham onward are conditional on the model placing Abraham's birth 130 years after Terah's birth, inferred by comparing Genesis 11:32, 12:4 and Acts 7:4. This is a harmonization, not a directly stated Abraham birth date. Joseph age at Jacob arrival derived using Genesis 41:46, 41:53-54, 45:6; Jacob age 130 in Genesis 47:9. Sarah's 90 years at Isaac's birth compared with Abraham's 100 (Genesis 17:17; 21:5) places her ten relative years after Abraham.
meta.corrections: Sarah was 10 years younger than Abraham (Genesis 17:17), not older. Relative birth 2018 and end 2145 are harmonization-derived.
meta.modelNotice: Genesis 5/11 relative chronology plus a CONDITIONAL Terah→Abraham age-130 harmonization using Genesis 11:32, 12:4 and Acts 7:4. Do not present it as a consensus absolute date.

audit.limitations: Internal consistency only; no independent manuscript-text chronology adjudication; absolute BCE dates are not inferred

meta.undatedPolicy: Document Scripture-stated lifespans and ages separately; do not place undated people on the relative-year axis.
meta.description: Undated people are grouped by biblical narrative period, never forced into shared calendar chronology.

peopleExplorerCoverage.explicitPolicy: Unknown lifespan is null, never zero or inferred.

meta.periodPolicy: Narrative-era grouping is not a claim of exact contemporaneity, lifespan, or BCE dating.
meta.timelineConnectionPolicy: Period-context-only events do not establish personal attendance, contemporaneity, or historical dates.
meta.directPolicy: Direct connections only where the named person is included in the referenced biblical narrative; not proof of lifespan alignment.
